# Gains: Get the User's Total Gains For a Period

Area overview and notes: [gains.md](../gains.md)

`GET /gains/summary` · tenant-scoped token

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `end_date` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date as a filter end date. |
| `start_date` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date to use as a filter start date. |

**Headers**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x-user-id` | string (uuid) | No | The Taxbit UUID of the account. Ignored if account_id is specified. |

**Response 200**: Get the user's total gains for a period

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array of object | Yes | Array of gain summary objects, one per asset. |
| `data[].asset_code` | string | Yes | The code/symbol of the asset (for example, 'BTC' for Bitcoin) |
| `data[].fiat_asset_code` | string | Yes | The code/symbol of the fiat asset used for cost basis (for example, 'USD') |
| `data[].latest_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date-time of the most recent transaction that disposed of this asset. |
| `data[].total_cost` | string | Yes | Total cost basis for all dispositions of this asset during the period. |
| `data[].total_quantity` | string | Yes | Total quantity of the asset that was disposed during the period. |
| `data[].total_gains_count` | integer | Yes | Number of gains for this asset during the period. |
| `data[].total_proceeds_missing_cost_basis` | string | No | Total proceeds from dispositions that have no cost basis available. Omitted if proceeds are 0. |
| `data[].total_proceeds_with_cost_basis` | string | Yes | Total proceeds from dispositions that have cost basis available. |
| `data[].total_quantity_missing_cost_basis` | string | No | Total quantity disposed that has no cost basis available. Omitted if quantity is 0. |
| `data[].total_quantity_with_cost_basis` | string | Yes | Total quantity disposed that has cost basis available. |
| `calculation_status` | string | No | Indicates the status of data calculations. Can be 'in_progress' when data may be incomplete due to ongoing calculations, or 'complete' when calculations have finished. One of: `in_progress`, `complete`. |

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 429 Too Many Requests
